info.title: esp32s3-av firmware API
info.description: Read-only JSON API of the ESP32-S3 audio/video firmware: device status, the SD-card recording listing, the OpenAPI document itself, and byte-range file download. No HTML, no UI, no upload. The API is unauthenticated and intended for the local network only. Every JSON body is `application/json`; the only non-JSON body is the recording file itself, served as `application/octet-stream` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`. Bodies are framed by ESP-IDF's HTTP server: a non-empty body, JSON or file, is streamed with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and carries no `Content-Length`; only an empty body (`HEAD`, `416`) carries `Content-Length: 0`. A URI outside every registered route is answered with the same JSON `ApiError` 404, and `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH` or `OPTIONS` on any route is answered with a JSON `ApiError` 405; every response a handler produces is JSON. A request httpd cannot parse is rejected by httpd before any handler runs. `temperature_c` is a reading of the on-die ESP32-S3 temperature sensor reported with one decimal; it is `null` when the sensor could not be installed, enabled or read at runtime, which is a sensor failure and not a permanently documented limitation.

servers.description: mDNS name the firmware advertises on the station interface
Example station address; read the boot log for the real one

tags.name: status
tags.description: Device state, including a bounded listing of the mount

tags.name: files
tags.description: Recordings on the mounted SD card

get.description: Returns the machine-readable list of endpoints. This is never an HTML page.

200.description: Every endpoint the server answers, as method/path pairs.

get.description: Firmware identity, uptime, station address, heap, SD-card volume and clock, RTSP configuration, recording state, the newest recording and the internal temperature sensor reading. Building it lists the mount and the `/rec` directory once but never reads file contents, so it also answers on a card-less boot.

200.description: The status document. Every property is always present; `recording_file` and `temperature_c` are nullable.

get.description: Lists the entries below the `/rec` directory of the mounted card, sorted by name, at most 200 entries, one directory level deep. `path` is mount-relative with a leading slash; download it from `/api/v1/files/{path}` without that slash.
Serves the checked-in OpenAPI 3.0.3 document the running firmware was built with.

schema.description: An OpenAPI 3.0.3 document; see this file for the shape.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Mount-relative file path, one or more `/`-separated percent-encoded segments, without a leading slash (for example `rec/REC_0001.avi`). `..`, `.`, empty segments, backslashes and NUL bytes are rejected.

get.description: Sends the file as `application/octet-stream` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, streamed with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and no `Content-Length`. With a single `Range: bytes=...` header the response is `206 Partial Content` and carries `Content-Range: bytes <start>-<end>/<total>`; a range that selects no byte is `416 Range Not Satisfiable` with `Content-Range: bytes */<total>` and a zero-length body. A multi-range request is ignored and the whole file is sent with `200`, which RFC 9110 section 14.2 permits. The body is streamed in 4 KiB chunks, never buffered whole.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: A single byte range, for example `bytes=0-1023`, `bytes=500-` or `bytes=-500`. Malformed or multi-range values are ignored and the whole file is served.

200.description: The whole file, or the whole file after an ignored range header.

Transfer-Encoding.description: Always `chunked`; the server does not announce a `Content-Length` for a body.
Always `chunked`; the server does not announce a `Content-Length` for a body.

head.description: The same status and the same `Accept-Ranges` / `Content-Range` headers as the `GET` operation, with an empty body. Because the body is empty, httpd frames the response with `Content-Length: 0` instead of `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: A single byte range, same rules as the `GET` operation.

endpoints.description: Every documented operation, in route-table order.

path.description: Path pattern as it appears in this document.

build.description: Build profile the image was compiled with.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since the timer subsystem started.

ip.description: Station IPv4 address, or `0.0.0.0` before DHCP assigns one.

hostname.description: mDNS hostname the device advertises; it answers as `<hostname>.local`.

mounted.description: Whether the SD card is mounted at the configured mount point.

total_bytes.description: Size of the mounted FAT filesystem in bytes; `0` when not mounted.

free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the mounted FAT filesystem; `0` when not mounted.

clock_khz.description: Real SD SPI clock in kHz; `0` when no card is mounted.

rtsp_port.description: Port the RTSP service is configured for.

rtsp_path.description: RTSP stream path, always beginning with a slash.

rtsp_running.description: Whether the media pipeline was started for this boot.

recording_enabled.description: Whether AVI recording is configured on for this boot.

recording_file.description: Mount-relative path of the newest recording (for example `rec/REC_0002.avi`), or `null` when there is none.

temperature_c.description: On-die temperature sensor reading in degrees Celsius with one decimal, or `null` when the sensor is unavailable.

heap_spiram_free.description: Free PSRAM in bytes; `0` on a build without PSRAM.

path.description: Mount-relative path with a leading slash.

ApiError.description: A JSON error body: every non-2xx JSON response uses this shape.

error.description: Canonical reason phrase of the status code (for example `Not Found`).

NotFound.description: No such file, a rejected download path, or a URI no route matches. Every 404 uses this JSON body.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The method is not served on this URI. `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH` and `OPTIONS` are answered by the catch-all handler with this JSON body; no `Allow` header is sent.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: The range selects no byte of the file. The response has a zero-length body, `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`, `Content-Length: 0` and `Content-Range: bytes */<total>`. An empty body is sent whole, so this response has no `Transfer-Encoding`.
